authority_invariant: PentaImmune and PentaEVIBuilder may discover, rank, repair-plan, test and preserve evidence only within authority already granted by CrownThrive/CHLOM and repository policy. They never manufacture D3, provider, credential, security, legal, economic, rights, deployment, certification or production authority.

autonomy_contract.scope: authorized CrownThrive repository-local issues, CI failures, tests, evidence, registry and documentation drift only

systems.purpose: Construct deterministic exact-head evidence bundles, provenance receipts, test bindings, rollback/fallback evidence and advisory repair memory for governed CrownThrive software operations.
systems.human_surface: Evidence bundles, certification inputs, repair receipts and provenance views
systems.authority_boundary: Constructs proof only. It cannot certify its own evidence, promote production, expand authority, convert HOLD into PASS or substitute historical evidence for current-head evidence.

five_stage.discover: Resolve the work order, source reference, exact Git head, observations, tests and required claims.
five_stage.govern: Apply exact-SHA, producer/verifier separation, evidence sufficiency, D3 reservation and rollback/fallback requirements.
five_stage.execute: Build a canonical JSON evidence bundle and SHA-256 receipt without granting certification or production state.
five_stage.verify: Require an independent verifier to reproduce receipt integrity, exact-head binding and required test/evidence conditions.
five_stage.preserve: Retain immutable evidence identifiers and advisory repair memory that always requires fresh retesting before reuse.

systems.purpose: Continuously discover and rank authorized repository-local weaknesses, create bounded reversible repair work, verify exact-head outcomes and preserve reusable repair intelligence without crossing governance boundaries.
systems.human_surface: Weakness queue, hunt results, repair plans, rollback/fallback state, certification evidence and repair memory
systems.authority_boundary: May autonomously prepare D0-D2 reversible repair candidates only through allowlisted handlers. D3, arbitrary commands, external target scanning, self-certification, self-promotion and authority expansion are prohibited.

five_stage.discover: Read authorized repository-local CI failures, test/evidence gaps, stale automation and explicitly admitted issue candidates.
five_stage.govern: Score severity, recurrence, confidence, reversibility, testability and blast radius while enforcing kill switch, retry caps and D3 reservation.
five_stage.execute: Emit one bounded repair plan per default cycle with deterministic rollback and fallback/redundancy; execution remains routed through PentaFactory/PentaPR.
five_stage.verify: Require exact-head tests, PentaEVIBuilder evidence and independent PentaCertify/PentaAssure PASS before governed merge or release.
five_stage.preserve: Store successful repair fingerprints and recipes as advisory memory only; every reuse requires prerequisite matching and fresh retesting.
